title: 读《白夜》: 幻想家之所以成为幻想家
title_en: Reading 'White Nights': Why the dreamer became a dreamer
excerpt: 或许幻想家从头到尾都知道这一切并不牢靠。只是当现实社会已经无法说服一个人继续投入什么东西的时候，再脆弱的幻象也会显得无比珍贵
excerpt_en: Perhaps the dreamer knew all along that none of this was solid. It's just that when reality can no longer convince a person to invest in anything, even the most fragile illusion becomes infinitely precious.
